sections.name: Olde Tymes Family Favorites
items: Have a short stack of our Buttermilk Pancakes with Sausage Patties between them and 2 Eggs on top, with a big bowl of grits. Coffee and a small Apple Juice finish this great meal.

Tyler works hard on our nation’s pipelines, and he is basic and hearty when it comes to breakfast. Home fries are mixed with onions, peppers, mushrooms, bacon and sausage, topped with 2 eggs cooked to order, and served with our bottomless coffee.

(fine, food, Get it?) My brother, the retired rocket scientist, makes his living now with Raku ceramics. Phil likes to make fun of our Tennessee country heritage by using “Faux French” spelling, but he keeps it simple and hearty when eating. Have 3 scrambled eggs topped with salsa, home fries topped with sausage gravy, biscuits, and your choice of bacon or sausage, with coffee and a small juice.
(Bagel & Lox) Sarah loves salmon, whether breakfast lunch or dinner. This is the clas-sic New York Deli breakfast with smoked salmon, toasted bagel, ca-pers, onions, tomatoes, and cream cheese.

Travis doesn’t like eggs, but he likes his sweets and sandwiches. When he’s in town, he likes to have a sausage and cheese sandwich on an English muffin with home fries and a short stack of Cinnamon Crisp. Then he has a large juice instead of coffee.
